inputThis:
$:set -euo pipefail
test ! -e conversations/README.md
mkdir -p conversations
cat > conversations/README.md <<'EOF'
# Conversations

This directory temporarily houses conversation records for specification, design, analysis, and related work in this repository.

Records stored here are working material, not the authoritative long-term conversation archive. Their presence does not imply that a record is complete, verified, or approved for permanent retention.

As the permanent storage location and retention procedure are defined, records may be reviewed and migrated or removed in accordance with that procedure. Preserve provenance and original content when transferring records.
EOF
git add -- conversations/README.md
git -c user.name='GPT-6' -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' commit -m 'docs: establish temporary conversations directory'
git push origin HEAD:main
git rev-parse HEAD
git show HEAD:conversations/README.md
outputThat: [main eb3fde8] docs: establish temporary conversations directory
